name: Citewise
description: Cite websites, books, articles and videos in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard and more. Your bibliography stays on your device.
_comment_host_permissions: <all_urls> is required because the popup fetches arbitrary user-pasted URLs (to read their HTML <meta> tags) and queries the CrossRef API for DOIs. These fetches originate from the extension's own popup context and must bypass the target pages' CORS headers, which is only possible with host_permissions. Citations are built locally; the only lookups go to CrossRef, PubMed (NCBI), Open Library, Google Books, and the oEmbed endpoints of YouTube, Vimeo and TikTok (to name a video's uploader). The one exception is feedback the user chooses to send (a message from the footer, or the reasons picked on the Remove Citewise page), which goes anonymously to the Citewise Worker. (This is the Chrome build; manifest.firefox.json is the Firefox MV3 variant.)
